sprite_sequence.text: No, no, no -- not on the very first day!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels panicked and flustered, with a burst of frustrated disbelief at being late on the very first day and a strong urge to fix it immediately.
sprite_sequence.label: exasperated

sprite_sequence.text: You've got to be kidding me. Today of all days?
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels openly exasperated and panicked at her bad luck, with a frustrated disbelief that her already stressful first day is being ruined by something beyond her control.
sprite_sequence.label: exasperated

sprite_sequence.text: Okay, okay. Don't panic. Fast walk, transfer, survive.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is trying to steady herself with brisk, self-motivating determination, masking rising stress and urgency with an upbeat, take-charge attitude.
sprite_sequence.label: natural_smile_cheerful

sprite_sequence.text: Made it! Barely! I am never trusting that line again.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels breathless relief and triumphant frustration at having arrived just in time, still keyed up from the morning’s chaos and determined to complain about it with lively exasperation.
sprite_sequence.label: exasperated

sprite_sequence.text: Year one, class three... end of the hall, right?
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s flustered but still upbeat and determined, mentally checking directions while trying to stay composed after her rough start.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s flustered and breathless from rushing in late, but still trying to stay upbeat and make a cheerful, apologetic first impression.
sprite_sequence.label: natural_smile_cheerful

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels a burst of embarrassed panic that she instantly covers with playful, self-deprecating humor, trying to stay upbeat despite realizing she has walked into the wrong room.
sprite_sequence.label: natural_smile_cheerful

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s mortified and flustered, but trying to cover her embarrassment with self-deprecating humor and a forced, upbeat attitude.
sprite_sequence.label: natural_smile_cheerful

sprite_sequence.text: What kind of map prints north in six-point font?!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s flustered and embarrassed, but covering it with loud, incredulous frustration and a self-mocking burst of energy.
sprite_sequence.label: exasperated

sprite_sequence.text: Come on, come on... please let the teacher be nice.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is flustered and anxious from her string of mishaps, but still pushing herself forward with hopeful, self-encouraging urgency and a little embarrassed desperation for a kind reception.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.text: Please tell me you're also in 1-3 and not judging me too hard.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels embarrassed but relieved to find a possible ally, and is nervously hoping for reassurance while trying to laugh off her own blunder.
sprite_sequence.label: slightly_happy_faint_smile

sprite_sequence.text: Then lead the way, hero. I'll owe you my life for at least one lunch break.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels relieved and amused, quickly shifting into playful gratitude and friendly trust as she lets the other girl take the lead.
sprite_sequence.label: natural_smile_cheerful

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is flustered and embarrassed from the chaos, but trying to recover with upbeat, polite confidence and a determined hope to make a good impression despite being late.
sprite_sequence.label: natural_smile_cheerful

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels embarrassed but relieved, trying to laugh off how transparently her chaotic morning has been while still keeping her upbeat, self-deprecating energy.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.text: Thank you! I swear this is not my usual brand.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels relieved and embarrassed at once, trying to laugh off her disastrous first impression while reassuring everyone that she’s usually much more composed.
sprite_sequence.label: slightly_happy_faint_smile

sprite_sequence.text: Okay. New term status: messy start, but not a total disaster.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels embarrassed but relieved, trying to laugh off the chaos and reassure herself that the day can still be salvaged.
sprite_sequence.label: slightly_happy_faint_smile
